sampling.fewer_than_20: audit all and report actual denominator
sampling.algorithm: Exclude already fully audited core/high-risk objects. Deduplicate by object_type + canonical source_native + original Evidence version/page/text/section (JSON sorted keys; retain actor, direction, field, amount, unit, period, status; exclude generated record/work IDs). Bucket remaining objects by actual object_type, sort within bucket by SHA256(seed|instrument|canonical_key); round-robin sorted bucket names until min(20,total) selected. Preserve selected keys before review; add all suspicious objects. Expand all affected same-kind objects on error.
sampling.accuracy: 已审/抽样准确率; correct audited unique objects / all audited unique objects; separate core/supplemental/suspicious then deduplicate; never assume unchecked correct

adaptation: WorkpaperFact is the actual delivered object. Core/high-risk independently identified; remaining qualitative/quantitative/optional fact types round-robin by the pre-existing seed and stable source-linked fact hash; fewer than 20 all checked. Additional doubts added, duplicates not counted twice.
